about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Investing in the human capital of Rwanda's youth since 1999.

history.title: Our History
history.content: Founded in September 1999 in Butare (Huye), Rwanda, Groupe Nos Enfants (GNE) was born from the vision of Father Modeste Mungwarareba, Dr. Laurien Ntezimana, and Ms. Antoinette Bruttin. Emerging in the aftermath of the 1994 Genocide, GNE was established to contribute to national reconstruction by focusing on the protection and empowerment of vulnerable children and youth.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To unlock the human potential of vulnerable youth through integrated solutions combining knowledge, hands-on skills, and entrepreneurship.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: A society where every child and young person is protected, enjoys equal opportunities, and becomes a self-reliant driver of sustainable development.

items.title: Empowering Young Mothers: Launch of a New Training Cycle
items.summary: GNE launches its 5th vocational training cycle in Kigali, supporting 50 young mothers with tailoring and business skills to achieve financial independence.
items.content:
We are thrilled to announce the start of our 5th vocational training cycle at the Kigali Empowerment Centre. This year, we have welcomed 50 determined young mothers who will undergo an intensive six-month program focused on tailoring, garment design, and essential business management skills.

Since its inception, our vocational training program has helped over 250 women transition from vulnerability to self-reliance. This cycle is particularly special as it incorporates a new digital literacy module, teaching participants how to market their products online and manage digital payments.

'This program is a lifeline for me,' says Marie, one of the new participants. 'I now have a path toward supporting my child and building a business of my own.'

We thank our partners and donors who make this work possible. Stay tuned for updates on their progress!

items.title: Back-to-School Campaign Success: 200 Children Supported
items.summary: Thanks to our generous donors, we've successfully provided school supplies and tuition support for 200 children in rural districts for the upcoming term.
items.content:
Our annual Back-to-School Drive has reached an incredible milestone this year. We are proud to share that 200 children across three rural districts now have everything they need to succeed in the new school term.

Each student received a comprehensive package including a durable school bag, textbooks, notebooks, mathematical sets, and a complete school uniform. Additionally, GNE has covered the tuition fees for 45 students who were at risk of dropping out due to financial hardship.

Education is the most powerful tool for breaking the cycle of poverty. By removing these immediate barriers, we are ensuring that these children can focus on what matters most: learning and growing.

A huge thank you to everyone who contributed to this campaign. Your generosity is shaping the leaders of tomorrow.

items.title: GNE Youth Innovation Hub: Bridging the Digital Divide
items.summary: Our new hub in Musanze is now open, providing internet access, digital literacy workshops, and mentorship for aspiring young entrepreneurs.
items.content:
The GNE Youth Innovation Hub in Musanze officially opened its doors this week, marking a significant step forward in our mission to empower youth through technology. The hub is designed to be a vibrant space where young people can access high-speed internet, state-of-the-art computers, and a supportive community of mentors.

Rwanda's future is digital, but many talented young people in rural areas remain disconnected from these opportunities. Our hub aims to bridge this divide by offering free workshops in coding, graphic design, and digital marketing.

Beyond technical skills, the hub will serve as an incubator for local startups. We provide co-working spaces and connect aspiring entrepreneurs with experienced business leaders who can help them refine their ideas and access funding.

We invite all youth in the Musanze area to visit us and explore how technology can unlock their potential.
